findings.claim: `getRelativeDistDir` returns a path without the leading slash when `root` is `/`. For every other root it keeps the leading slash.
findings.rationale: For a normal root like `/proj`, `rootPrefix` is `/proj/` and `normalizedDistDir.slice(normalizedRoot.length)` gives `/node_modules/vitest/dist`, with the leading slash. When `root` is `/`, `normalizedRoot` is `/` (length 1), so `slice(1)` removes the leading slash and gives `usr/lib/node_modules/vitest/dist`. Callers that join this to the root or match it against root-relative ids like `/node_modules/...` will get the wrong result when the project root is the filesystem root. The slice should use `rootPrefix.length - 1`, or handle the `/` case separately.
